scope: development-only monotone calibration of the validated spatial-Prithvi scene ensemble

calibration.fold_offset: current negative logit p95 minus raw ensemble negative logit p95
calibration.aggregate_rule: minimum selection-fold offset minus the fixed conservative margin
calibration.direction: negative only; every scene score must strictly decrease

gates.selection: every fold has calibrated negative logit p95 and fixed-threshold false positives no higher than current, with AP exactly preserved
gates.confirmation: the identical fixed offset passes the same rules once on folds 0/1

invariants: No fresh CloudSEN score or paper-cache input is loaded by the calibrator.
Only selection-fold negative labels determine the offset; confirmation folds are evaluated once.
A constant logit offset is strictly monotone, so scene ranking, AP, AUROC, and matched-FPR recall are invariant.
Failure writes no artifact and blocks a calibrated fresh-safety replay.
